Hotel Sales & Representation

Hotel Sales Representation in Kolkata

Kolkata hotel sales should distinguish airport transit, central city meetings and convention demand around New Town, with separate plans for festival periods.

Discuss your project

Qualify the destination inside the city

Match proposals to where guests work, meet or arrive. A New Town convention, a central Kolkata event and airport transit differ in distance, invoicing and meal requirements.

Prepare for festival demand and movement

Request road access and arrival guidance from operations for busy festival windows. Set conditions for advance room blocks, meal guarantees and late check-in before quoting.
